name: Cryonic-Nunatak
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, massive canyon systems. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The colonists of the ancient alien ruins kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
